# CogniSynth

## Overview
GraphRAG pipeline for research papers, with a Neo4j knowledge graph, two-pass vision enrichment of figures, and claim checking.

## Technology
Neo4j, GraphRAG, BGE-Reranker, Ragas, Three.js

## Source and scope
Reviewed 2026-10-12. Evidence classification: owner_reported.
No public implementation is linked. The description is owner-reported.
No benchmark score, accuracy guarantee, or latency promise is asserted by this summary.

## Implementation
The owner describes PDF parsing with Docling, entity extraction with GLiNER and a Groq vision model, and canonical entity deduplication.
The described retrieval pipeline combines graph and text evidence, with BGE-M3 embeddings and BGE-Reranker-V2-M3.
The described answer checks compare extracted claims against retrieved text. They do not guarantee factual correctness.
